notes: Every list goes through this component. Items render via Text atom (per-item content). Marker pattern matches Heading.media — single media prop accepts { component: 'Icon'|'Shape', ...atomProps }. Pipeline strips media in textonly (native bullets replace). Colour comes from the global .color--{name} mixin.

_rules.action: List auto-injects semanticRole='background' on the Shape — runtime guarantee, JSON value (if any) is overridden. Shape is wallpaper for the child Icon; child owns aria/label.

contentList.description: Array of items. Each item is a string (plain text) or { contentLink, href } (linked item). Pipeline content key.

brandColor._description: Marker colour. 'text' = body text scale, always readable.

media._description: Per-item marker atom. mediaBg=false: single Icon | Shape. mediaBg=true: Shape wrapping a child Icon via its own media prop — set the Shape's semanticRole='background' to declare wallpaper intent (child owns meaning).

mediaBg._description: true = media is a Shape wrapping a child atom (background container).

mediaBgSize._description: Padding inside the Shape wrapper around the child icon. Only used when mediaBg=true; value is forwarded to the nested Shape atom.
mediaBgSize._note: Implicit baseline is 'normal' (applied by Shape's own default). Omit to use.

mediaSize._description: Marker size. 'auto' inherits item text size via em.
mediaSize._note: Implicit baseline is 'auto' (no size prop forwarded to child atom; CSS em-based sizing inherits text size). Omit to use.

textStyle._description: Partial spread of Text styling props forwarded to each item's Text. List controls content + 'as' internally.

variant._description: default=bullets, numbered=ol, none=no markers, inline=horizontal, dot=custom circles.

dotSize._description: Dot marker size for variant=dot only.

spacing._note: Implicit baseline is 'normal' (no .list--spacing-* class emitted). Omit to use.
